subject: dec
title: (R)DEC.------DYM.F.
description: Diagram in MID-W-16. (R)DEC (the reality of decentralization) is crossed with DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). The pairing is structurally pointed: real decentralization (not the concept) crossed with dynamic functionalism asks what actual decentralization *does* when it operates as a dynamic-functional principle (rather than a political slogan). INFO-CON (information convergence) branches from the main line and opens into LK-IMP (linkage implications) and MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). MTA-RT-SIGN opens into DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism), which opens into PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → TR (transformation) and into (P)TM (the point of idea completion of terminology—or terms of a definition).
